summary: Frontend-only testing of BFM Magazine Builder Canva-like visual editor. All 10 requested features verified working end-to-end via admin login -> Magazine Builder tab -> open existing magazine (Priya Sharma) -> editor. Confirmed: magazine list, editor layout (Pages sidebar/Canvas/Toolbar/Layers+Properties sidebar), resize handles on selection, complete Properties panel (Font/Size/Color/Opacity/Alignment/Line Height/Letter Space/Position X-Y-W-H), Add Page template modal shows all 10 templates (Blank, Cover, Profile, Photo Grid, Two Column, Interview, Full Bleed Image, Quote, Full Page Ad, Half Page Ad), Add Text/Rectangle/Circle/Line/Image tools functional (new elements appeared in Layers panel), PDF button visible, Instagram dropdown shows 3 formats (Portrait 1080x1350, Square 1080x1080, Story 1080x1920), Save produces 'Magazine saved!' toast. No console errors during flow.

issues: Toolbar has 20+ icon-only buttons packed in a single row; on smaller widths could overflow. Consider grouping (Insert / Arrange / View) with visible dividers/labels.

'BANGALORE FASHION MAGAZINE' header text appears clipped/overlapping ('MAGAZINE' cut off) on the cover page - the Magazine Title element may extend beyond canvas bounds or overlap with logo. Non-blocking but visually off.

action_items: Minor: fix Magazine Title element positioning on Cover template - 'MAGAZINE' word visually clipped/overlapped by the BFM logo circle on the auto-generated cover.
Consider splitting MagazineBuilder.jsx (1865 lines) into subcomponents (Toolbar, LayersPanel, PropertiesPanel, PageTemplateModal, Canvas) for maintainability - exceeds 700-line guideline.

Optional: add data-testid to toolbar buttons (Add Text/Rectangle/Circle/Line/Image/Undo/Redo/Add Page/Toggle Layers/Toggle Grid) and PageTemplate modal buttons to make future automation more robust; currently relying on title attributes which works but is less standardized.
critical_code_review_comments: MagazineBuilder.jsx = 1865 lines (was 1231 in iter 13, now grown). Violates <700 line guideline; break into components.
Toolbar buttons use only title attributes - add data-testid for testability per project convention.
PageTemplate modal cards lack data-testid - hard to target individual templates in tests.
seed_data_creation: None - used existing 'Priya Sharma - BFM Feature' magazine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Editor route: login -> /admin -> click 'Magazine Builder' tab -> click a magazine card ([data-testid='magazine-card-<id>']) opens the editor inline. Toolbar buttons keyed by title attr: 'Add Text (T)', 'Add Rectangle', 'Add Circle', 'Add Line/Divider', 'Add Image', 'Add Page', 'Undo (Ctrl+Z)', 'Redo (Ctrl+Shift+Z)', 'Toggle Grid', 'Toggle Layers Panel', 'Preview Mode', 'Duplicate Page', 'Delete Page'. Save/PDF/IG buttons have data-testid ('save-magazine-btn','export-pdf-btn','export-instagram-btn','export-ig-portrait/square/story'). IG dropdown opens on click. Save toast: 'Magazine saved!'. Elements added via toolbar appear in Layers panel (right sidebar). Clicking a layer/text selects element and shows resize handles + Properties panel.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs. All requested features working.
